_doc: judge_solidity.py fixtures (round H item 1). Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1) in the 512x224 frame. `state` names a private cold checkpoint ($WORK/states/<state>.ps2st, never in the repository), `frames` the --frames count, `present_key` the judged present (the title displays the buffer a frame finished one vsync later: present K shows frame K-1). `twin` names the PCSX2 2.7.329 SaveFrame (unattended warp + PINE recipe, warp_notes.md / solidity_notes.md) by its f<frame> ordinal in the private run directory.
